parsed.rationale_overall: System A provides more specific, actionable recommendations with concrete tickers (SHV, VGSH, SUB, VNQ, MUB) and precise dollar amounts, plus addresses tax optimization which is highly relevant for a retiree. System B has slightly more calibrated language and includes a sensible DRIP suggestion, but contains a factual error (claiming $120k deployment at 4-5% yields $9,600-12,000 which overstates the incremental gain vs cash) and less specific redeployment vehicles.
